text: Prover questions board (side wall, above lectern): headline 'Make card 81 talk about itself.' is readable at ~3m, but the second line ('Then feed it to the Prover...'?) and the 'ABOUT CARD 81' header are blurry thin text I cannot reliably read from where I'd stand to use the lectern. tick ~27400, pos -18.6,34.4 yaw 306.

Prover lectern: standing at it and looking down (1.6m, pitch 31), the three answer buttons are plain dark blocks with no visible label. Pos -19.9,35.6 yaw 3. (Questions not unlocked yet; labels may appear later.)

Prover main board from the lectern (~4-5m, yaw 34): card texts readable, but the board's header line ('THE PROVER - it never...') and the right-hand output column ('Empty. Press a card on the desk in front of you to feed it in.') are tiny blurry text, unreadable from here. tick ~32000.

Prover room plaque 'A sentence about itself' (corner wall right of the card cabinet): from ~3m the title reads but all body text (6-7 lines) is an unreadable smear, and the plaque's black border renders as a broken, jagged double line. pos -22.3,30.7 yaw ~120.

Same plaque from ~2m, closest comfortable reading distance: body text still low-res and partly illegible ('Feed the Prover a card and it tries every possible proof...', 'Every card has a number...'). Text is too small for the plaque size.

List room board (Librarian's List): the 8x8 tile grid and 'your row' are crammed into the left third of the board; the right two-thirds is empty, while the explanatory line next to 'your row' ('...tile n is the opposite of row n's tile n') runs in tiny text to the board's right edge. Header 'THE LIBRARIAN'S LIST - NOW WITH YOUR ROW ADDED AT THE TOP' is tiny and slanted. Viewed from just inside the List by the Prover door, pos -14.9,32.5.
